pattern: に引き換え（にひきかえ）
purpose: Make a sharp comparison between contrasting cases.
keywords: N + に引き換え; clause + のに引き換え
In contrast to yesterday, today is warm.
Unlike his older brother, the younger one says little.
Despite its excellent reputation, the actual item was ordinary.
formation: N + に引き換え; clause + のに引き換え
restrictions: Often compares people or past and present unfavorably.
mistake: The second case should contrast meaningfully with the first.
